## Pull request overview

Extends `@object-ui/plugin-aggrid` to expose additional “enterprise-style” AG Grid features (editing, export, status bar aggregations, context menu, column defaults, and event callbacks) via the ObjectUI schema, along with documentation and versioning updates.

**Changes:**
- Added new schema/type surface area for editing, export, status bar, context menu, column defaults, and callbacks.
- Implemented CSV export UI + handlers, status bar panel wiring, context menu generation, and callback plumbing in the lazy-loaded grid implementation.
- Expanded README + docs demos and bumped package version/changelog to `0.4.0`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 11 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-aggrid/src/types.ts | Adds new TypeScript interfaces and extends `AgGridSchema` with new feature flags/configs. |
| packages/plugin-aggrid/src/index.tsx | Re-exports new types, forwards new schema props to the lazy implementation, and registers new configurable inputs. |
| packages/plugin-aggrid/src/AgGridImpl.tsx | Implements export UI/handler, status bar panels, context menu items, and event callback wiring. |
| packages/plugin-aggrid/package.json | Bumps plugin version to `0.4.0`. |
| packages/plugin-aggrid/README.md | Documents new feature set and provides updated usage examples. |
| packages/plugin-aggrid/CHANGELOG.md | Adds `0.4.0` release notes for the new features. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-aggrid.mdx | Adds interactive demos and expanded Schema API docs for the new feature surface. |
</details>

`handleExportCSV` only checks `gridRef.current`, but that doesn't guarantee `gridRef.current.api` is available yet. If export is triggered before the grid is ready, the later `...api.exportDataAsCsv(...)` call can throw. Guard on `gridRef.current?.api` and/or disable the export UI until `onGridReady` has run.

Custom context menu items trigger `callbacks.onCellClicked` with a synthetic `any` event + `customAction`. This overloads the meaning of `onCellClicked` and forces consumers to type-cast. Prefer adding a dedicated callback (e.g. `onContextMenuAction`) with a well-defined payload (action id + row/cell context).

`customItem.icon` is passed through to AG Grid's menu item `icon` property. If the schema can come from untrusted sources, this may enable HTML injection depending on how AG Grid renders the icon string. Consider restricting `icon` to safe values (e.g., emoji only, or a predefined icon name -> component mapping) or sanitizing/escaping before passing it through.

README claims "Cell & Row Editing" includes "validation support", but no validation mechanism is implemented or exposed in the schema/callbacks. Either document what validation means here (and how to hook it up) or remove the claim to avoid misleading users.
```suggestion
- **Cell & Row Editing**: Inline editing using AG Grid's built-in editors
```

New inputs were added to the component registry starting here (e.g. `editable`, `singleClickEdit`, export/status/context menu configs). The existing `src/index.test.ts` only asserts the older input set; adding assertions for these new inputs would help prevent regressions in the component metadata.

`AgGridCallbacks.onExport` allows `format: 'excel'`, but the implementation only exports CSV (`exportDataAsCsv`) and the UI text also only mentions CSV. Either implement Excel export or restrict the type/docs to `'csv'` so the public API matches behavior.
```suggestion
  onExport?: (data: any[], format: 'csv') => void;
```

`getContextMenuItems` uses `callbacks` (for custom menu actions) but `callbacks` is missing from the `useCallback` dependency array, which can lead to stale handlers if callbacks change. Include `callbacks` in the dependency list.

The docs label the complete demo as "Enterprise Features", but this package only declares `ag-grid-community`/`ag-grid-react` as peer dependencies. If some of these features require `ag-grid-enterprise` and a commercial license (e.g., status bar/range selection/charts/context menu in many AG Grid versions), please document the requirement explicitly and/or add an optional peer dependency so consumers aren't surprised by runtime warnings/missing functionality.

These new schema props are typed as `any` even though the PR introduces corresponding TS interfaces. Consider typing them as `AgGridCallbacks` / `ExportConfig` / `StatusBarConfig` / `ColumnConfig` / `ContextMenuConfig` (or using `AgGridSchema` directly) to preserve type safety.

The `exportConfig` input description says "CSV/Excel export", but only CSV export is implemented. Update this description (and related docs/types) or add Excel export support before advertising it.
```suggestion
        description: 'Configure CSV export: { enabled: true, fileName: "data.csv" }',
```
